import math

def integral(n, N=200000):
    # I_n = ∫_0^1 n cos^2 x/(1+n^2 x^2) dx; with t=n x then t=tan(th):
    # I_n = ∫_0^{atan n} cos^2(tan(th)/n) dth  (smooth integrand), Simpson rule
    b = math.atan(n)
    h = b / N
    f = lambda th: math.cos(math.tan(th) / n) ** 2
    s = f(0) + f(b)
    for i in range(1, N):
        s += (4 if i % 2 else 2) * f(i * h)
    return s * h / 3

claim = math.pi / 4
expected = math.pi / 2
for n in [10, 100, 1000, 10**4, 10**5]:
    v = integral(n)
    print(n, v, "diff to pi/2:", v - expected, "diff to pi/4:", v - claim)

# Rigorous bound: |I_n - atan(n)| = ∫_0^1 n sin^2 x/(1+n^2x^2) dx <= ∫_0^1 x^2 n/(1+n^2 x^2) dx <= 1/(2n)
n = 10**5
v = integral(n)
bound = 1 / (2 * n)
print("|I_n - atan(n)| =", abs(v - math.atan(n)), "<= bound", bound)
print("Analytic: limit = lim atan(n) = pi/2 =", expected, "; claimed pi/4 =", claim)
print("(numerical part only samples; the bound plus atan(n)->pi/2 proves the limit)")
if abs(v - claim) < 1e-3:
    print("CHECK PASS")
elif abs(v - expected) < 1e-3 and abs(v - math.atan(n)) <= bound:
    print("CHECK FAIL")
else:
    print("CHECK UNKNOWN")
